_ui.title: The Bible in One Scroll — the film
_ui.sub: From creation to the new heaven and new earth — 21 scenes, each painted in its own style, tell one story. The pictures are drawn live in your browser.

_ui.shareText: From creation to the new heaven and new earth — the Bible story in 13 minutes

creation.“하나님이 지으신 그 모든 것을 보시니\n보시기에 심히 좋았더라”:
“And God saw everything that he had made,
and behold, it was very good”

cross.“해가 빛을 잃고 온 땅에 어둠이 임하여”: “there was darkness over the whole land”
cross.“해가 빛을 잃고\n온 땅에 어둠이 임하여”:
“there was darkness
over the whole land”
cross.“그가 찔림은 우리의 허물 때문이요”: “But he was pierced for our transgressions”
cross.“그가 찔림은\n우리의 허물 때문이요”:
“But he was pierced
for our transgressions”
cross.“그가 채찍에 맞으므로 우리는 나음을 받았도다”: “and with his wounds we are healed”
cross.“그가 채찍에 맞으므로\n우리는 나음을 받았도다”:
“and with his wounds
we are healed”
cross.그 십자가에 달려야 했던 사람은: The one who should have hung on that cross

fall.“여호와 하나님의 낯을 피하여\n동산 나무 사이에 숨은지라”:
“hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God
among the trees of the garden”
fall.“여자의 후손은 네 머리를 상하게 할 것이요”: “her offspring; he shall bruise your head”
fall.“여자의 후손은\n네 머리를 상하게 할 것이요”:
“her offspring;
he shall bruise your head”
fall.타락 직후 주신 첫 복음의 약속: The first promise of the gospel, given right after the Fall

patriarch.“하늘을 우러러 뭇별을 셀 수 있나 보라”: “Look toward heaven, and number the stars, if you are able to number them”
patriarch.“하늘을 우러러\n뭇별을 셀 수 있나 보라”:
“Look toward heaven, and number the stars,
if you are able to number them”

rise.“그가 말씀 하시던 대로 살아나셨느니라”: “for he has risen, as he said”
rise.“그가 말씀 하시던 대로\n살아나셨느니라”:
“for he has risen,
as he said”

Yet the stage was quietly being set.
silence.“때가 차매 하나님이 그 아들을 보내사\n여자에게서 나게 하시고”:
“But when the fullness of time had come,
God sent forth his Son, born of woman”
